tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: The ground behind everything: the window, the phone screen, the popup frame. Panels sit on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised modules: header bar, sidebar, item list, item detail, dialogs, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Key faces (default buttons), raised vault buttons, the selected list row, tiles.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: inputs, field wells, list wells, switch tracks, segmented controls. Text inside a well uses ink or ink-2, never ink-3.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The lip under a panel and hairline dividers inside wells. Decorative only.

tokens.name: edge-key
tokens.usage: The 3px lip under a key face and a raised row; what makes a control look pressable.

tokens.name: hi
tokens.usage: 1px top highlight inside a panel, so it reads as a lit edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row subtitles, hints, descriptions. 4.5:1 on panel, raised and well in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Engraved labels and counts on panel and raised only. In light it falls under 4.5:1 on well, so use ink-2 there.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Border of engraved tags and the unlit status light. Not for text.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The Kandado colour: the go key (one per view), the active vault, the selected-row ring, links, the logo body, switches that are on.

tokens.name: green-edge
tokens.usage: Lip under a green key.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill. Dark text in the dark theme, since the green is lighter there.

tokens.name: dark-key
tokens.usage: The contrast key: the lock button and the item initial badge. Flips to a light key in dark.

tokens.name: dark-key-edge
tokens.usage: Lip under a dark key.

tokens.name: on-dark-key
tokens.usage: Text on a dark key.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: Delete forever, Delete account, field errors. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-edge
tokens.usage: Lip under a danger key.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger banner.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning banner (unencrypted export, restore notes). Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: led-ok
tokens.usage: Status light: synced, healthy, done, step complete. Never alone: always beside a word.

tokens.name: led-warn
tokens.usage: Status light: locked, needs attention, waiting, current step. Never alone: always beside a word.

tokens.name: vault-green
tokens.usage: Green vault light. Default for the first vault (Personal). Old name: teal. A vault shows its light, never a coloured fill: on panel or raised (3:1 or more in both themes), never directly on a well (under 3:1 in Enamel). Always beside the vault name.

tokens.name: vault-orange
tokens.usage: Orange vault light. Same hue as led-warn: in a list of vaults it reads as a colour because the vault name sits beside it. Old name: coral. A vault shows its light, never a coloured fill: on panel or raised (3:1 or more in both themes), never directly on a well (under 3:1 in Enamel). Always beside the vault name.

tokens.name: vault-sky
tokens.usage: Sky vault light. Old name: sky. A vault shows its light, never a coloured fill: on panel or raised (3:1 or more in both themes), never directly on a well (under 3:1 in Enamel). Always beside the vault name.

tokens.name: vault-plum
tokens.usage: Plum vault light. Old name: plum. A vault shows its light, never a coloured fill: on panel or raised (3:1 or more in both themes), never directly on a well (under 3:1 in Enamel). Always beside the vault name.

tokens.name: vault-amber
tokens.usage: Amber vault light. Darker in Enamel than the redesign draft (#D9A21B, 2.0:1 on panel) so it reaches 3:1. Old name: brass. A vault shows its light, never a coloured fill: on panel or raised (3:1 or more in both themes), never directly on a well (under 3:1 in Enamel). Always beside the vault name.

tokens.name: vault-graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite vault light, for a quiet vault (Archive). Lit with a glow, unlike the unlit tag light. Old name: moss. A vault shows its light, never a coloured fill: on panel or raised (3:1 or more in both themes), never directly on a well (under 3:1 in Enamel). Always beside the vault name.

tokens.name: lcd
tokens.usage: The LCD display: two-factor codes, recovery phrase, lock state, pairing codes, generated passwords. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: Lit digits and text on the LCD, and lit countdown bars.

tokens.name: lcd-dim
tokens.usage: Unlit countdown bars and the face of keys set into the LCD.

tokens.name: lcd-label
tokens.usage: Small labels on the LCD (TWO-FACTOR CODE, STRONG · 118 BITS).

tokens.name: lcd-warn
tokens.usage: Warning text on the LCD (PERMANENT, 3 TO FIX).

tokens.name: lcd-edge
tokens.usage: Lip under a key set into the LCD.

tokens.name: well-shadow
tokens.usage: The inner shadow that sinks a well.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every control.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign-in, unlock and welcome screens only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Item name on detail, page titles in settings.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and dialog headings, list titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kandado locks after 5 minutes of inactivity.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and section labels, set in capitals, like text stamped into metal.

styles.name: segment
styles.usage: Options in a segmented control, in capitals.

styles.name: secret
styles.usage: Usernames, passwords, URLs, card numbers: anything typed back exactly.

styles.name: lcd-code
styles.usage: Two-factor codes on desktop, grouped in threes. 30–40px on mobile and in the popup.

styles.name: lcd-text
styles.usage: Status readouts and recovery words on the LCD.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between countdown bars and segmented options.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between keys in a row; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between fields; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between panels, and panel padding on desktop and mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The window inset: panels sit 16px in from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Detail and dialog padding; between sections in settings.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Settings page side padding; onboarding sections.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Engraved tags.

tokens.name: radius-key-sm
tokens.usage: Small keys and segmented options.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keys, inputs, field wells, nav buttons.

tokens.name: radius-well
tokens.usage: List wells and the LCD.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and the extension popup frame.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile header panel.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Switch tracks and status lights.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: The lip under a key face. Pressing shifts the key down 2px and shortens it to 1px.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels: a lit top edge and a lip.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sinks a well, input or switch track into the panel.

tokens.name: shadow-lcd
tokens.usage: Sinks the LCD glass.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The only floating shadow: dialogs, popovers, the autofill dropdown, the save banner, bottom sheets.
